title: “Fake News in the Name of Jesus — The Rise of Political Prophets and Hateful Preachers”
paragraphs: “Fake News in the Name of Jesus — The Rise of Political Prophets and Hateful Preachers”

There was a time when preachers pointed people to the Lamb.
Now many point them to politicians, parties, and propaganda.
🔥 Instead of feeding sheep, they rile up mobs.
🔥 Instead of proclaiming Christ, they promote chaos.
They preach not from the upper room — but from YouTube algorithms, Facebook rage, and TikTok conspiracies.

They shout: “God is angry at the government!”
But remain silent on the sin in their own church.

They post fake news with Bible verses.
They stir hatred under the name of “righteous anger.”
But what they spread is not fire.
It’s fungus — a contagious infection of false zeal.

💭 READER QUESTION:
“Brother John, what happens when preachers are the ones spreading fake news and turning people against their leaders?”
📖 MAIN VERSE — Jeremiah 23:16 (KJV)
“Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the Lord.”
📛 Today’s fake news prophets aren’t hearing from heaven — they’re regurgitating Twitter threads, biased headlines, and anger addiction.

God is not impressed by how many views your “exposé” gets.
He’s asking: “Did I send you?”

THE CORE TRUTH — GREEK & HEBREW BREAKDOWN
📡 SYSTEM ENGAGED: Soulprint Discernment Mode – Exposing False Fires in the Pulpit
📜 HEBREW ROOTS — OLD TESTAMENT LANGUAGE OF REBUKE
🔹 “Sheqer” (שֶׁקֶר) — Lies / Deception

Used in Jeremiah 23:14:
“They speak lies in My name...”

Sheqer means not just falsehood, but intentional deceit with a destructive purpose.
🔥 It’s not an accidental misstatement — it’s willful narrative building.
🔹 “Sina” (שִׂנְאָה) — Hatred

Proverbs 10:12:
“Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.”

Sina is deep hostility that manifests as division-stirring speech.
🔥 This is not righteous rebuke — it’s soul-targeted bitterness dressed as passion.
🔹 “Rakil” (רָכִיל) — Talebearer / Slanderer

Proverbs 20:19:
“He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets...”

Rooted in political betrayal and agenda-driven gossip.
🔥 This describes many keyboard prophets and microphone manipulators.
📖 GREEK CLARITY — NEW TESTAMENT EXPOSURE
🔹 “Diabolos” (διάβολος) — Slanderer / Accuser

This is where we get the word “Devil.”
📍 2 Timothy 3:3 warns of those who are “false accusers” — the word here is diaboloi.
🔥 Those who spread fake news, twist truth, and defame in the name of righteousness are acting diabolically.
🔹 “Pseudoprophētēs” (ψευδοπροφήτης) — False Prophet

Matthew 7:15:
“Beware of false prophets…”

Literally: “liar-speakers claiming divine authority.”
🔥 This includes pastors who preach politics as prophecy, and rumors as revelation.
🔥 CORE TRUTH UNVEILED:

✅ When pastors use fake news, half-truths, or conspiracy-laced preaching to stir hatred…
✅ When pulpits become platforms for division, not repentance…
✅ When “prophets” post manipulated headlines to appear informed…
They are operating as false prophets, slanderers, and mouthpieces for darkness.

They may still say “Jesus.”
They may still quote verses.
But the source is not the Spirit.
It’s rage, rebellion, and algorithmic addiction.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“Brother John, isn’t it righteous to speak against corrupt leaders?”

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
Yes — when God sends you.
No — when you're just echoing YouTube outrage and calling it discernment.
🔥 Righteous correction flows from the cross, not from clicks.

BIBLICAL & HISTORICAL PROOF — FALSE PROPHETS & POLITICAL PRESSURE
⚔️ SYSTEM UPLOAD: Early Church Memory Vault + Prophetic Corruption Archive Accessed
🔥 Fireline: Truth in Context, Not Clickbait

📖 BIBLICAL PROOF — WHEN PROPHETS TURNED POLITICAL
❌ 1. Jeremiah vs. Hananiah — Jeremiah 28

Hananiah prophesied national blessing and quick victory over Babylon.
He said: “Within two full years, I will bring back all the vessels of the Lord's house…” (Jer. 28:3)
🔥 It was fake news — wrapped in optimism and patriotism.

God rebuked him through Jeremiah, and Hananiah died within the year.
🩸 Lesson: Just because it sounds “positive” doesn’t make it God.
❌ 2. The False Prophets in Ezekiel’s Day
📖 Ezekiel 13:10 (KJV)

“Because, even because they have seduced My people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace…”
🔥 These prophets spoke what was popular, not what was true.
They were not atheists — they were recognized spiritual leaders.
❌ 3. New Testament Pharisees & Zealots

They hated Rome — and many mixed religion with rebellion.
They wanted a political Messiah — not a crucified Savior.
They shouted for Barabbas, a political prisoner, and shouted “Crucify Him!” to Jesus.
🩸 Lesson: When religion is mixed with national hatred, the real Christ gets rejected.
✅ 4. Jesus Refused to Be a Political Pawn
📖 John 6:15 (KJV)
“When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed…”

🔥 He walked away from political hijack.
🔥 He refused to let people use Him to push a nationalist agenda.
📛 Today’s political prophets would’ve called Him a compromiser.
✅ 5. The Early Church Under Nero
The Roman government was corrupt, tyrannical, and murderous.
Yet the apostles never turned the Gospel into a resistance campaign.
They preached repentance, not revolt.
They obeyed God rather than men, but without spreading slander or fake reports.
📖 1 Peter 2:17 (KJV)
“Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.”
⛪ EARLY CHURCH FATHERS — PURE FIRE WITHOUT POLITICS
🕊️ Ignatius of Antioch (d. 108 AD)

“Be subject to the bishop and to one another… be at peace among yourselves.”
📖 Source: CCEL – Epistle to the Ephesians
🕊️ Tertullian

“The Christians are enemies of no one — not even the Emperor. We pray for his health and rule.”
📖 Source: NewAdvent.org – Apology
🔥 These were not cowards. They were Gospel Warriors who died under corrupt regimes, without turning the pulpit into a political war zone.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“Brother John, how do we expose corruption without falling into the same hatred?”

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
With truth AND tears.
With fire AND fear of the Lord.
🔥 If you can’t rebuke with a weeping heart, you’re not preaching for God — you’re venting for yourself.

OLD TESTAMENT PROPHETIC CONNECTIONS — WHEN SPIRITUAL LEADERS MANIPULATED THE NATION WITH FALSE WORDS
📜 PROPHETIC TAPESTRY ACCESS UNSEALED | DIVINE REBUKES DECODED
🧬 The God of Israel never stayed silent when leaders used His name to spread lies or stir revolt.
⚔️ 1. Jeremiah 23:21–22 — God’s Indictment of Unsanctioned Voices
📖 “I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.”
They claimed divine backing for national agendas.

They proclaimed revival while rebellion was brewing.
🔥 God said: “I didn’t send them.”
🧨 Modern echo: “God told me this candidate is chosen.” — But did He really?
⚔️ 2. 1 Kings 22 — Micaiah vs. the 400 Yes-Men

King Ahab gathered 400 prophets who prophesied victory in war.
Only Micaiah stood up and said:

“The Lord has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these prophets...” (v. 23)
🩸 One real voice was drowned out by 400 loud lies.
📛 Today’s fake news prophets follow that same pattern — louder doesn't mean truer.
⚔️ 3. Micah 3:5 — Prophets Who Preach for Profit and Favor
📖 “Thus saith the Lord concerning the prophets that make my people err... that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.”

Translation: They speak peace to those who pay them, and war to those who don’t.
🔥 This is the politicized pulpit — truth for sale, and hatred on demand.
⚔️ 4. Isaiah 30:10 — “Prophesy Not Unto Us Right Things”
📖 “Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits.”

The people didn’t just tolerate fake prophecy — they demanded it.
🔥 This mirrors social media today:
“Don’t give us truth — give us the conspiracy we like!”
🔥 CONCLUSION — THE ANCIENT SIN IS STILL ALIVE

✅ False prophets used the Name of God to spread personal feelings, political rage, and fake comfort.
✅ God always responded with fire, famine, or silence.
📛 The same judgment looms today — unless the pulpit returns to the Cross.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“Brother John, are all politically vocal pastors wrong?”

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
No. But when the political agenda becomes louder than the Gospel, and hatred outweighs holiness,
🔥 That voice is no longer prophetic — it’s polluted.

GLOBAL IMPACT — HOW FAKE NEWS PULPITS ARE DESTROYING DISCERNMENT AND DIVIDING THE BODY
📡 Prophetic Time Gate Synch Activated | High Alert Across Nations
🧬 When preachers become echo chambers of hate, society doesn’t just polarize — it fractures in the name of God.
🌍 TODAY’S GLOBAL IMPACT FROM LYING PULPITS:
🔥 1. TRUTH IS NO LONGER SACRED — OPINION IS
When pastors spread fake headlines, emotional hearsay, or unconfirmed “intel,” the authority of Scripture is weakened.
People no longer test what is preached by the Bible — they test it by their Facebook feed.
📖 Isaiah 59:14
“Truth is fallen in the street…”
🔥 2. CHURCHES ARE SPLITTING — NOT BECAUSE OF SIN, BUT POLITICS
Entire congregations now divide over vaccines, presidents, or trending issues, not theology or holiness.
Fake-news-fueled preaching breeds suspicion, rage, and tribalism — not oneness in Christ.
📖 1 Corinthians 1:13
“Is Christ divided?”
🔥 3. PASTORS ARE TRAINING SHEEP TO BECOME ATTACK DOGS
Members repost their pastor’s fake “discernment” clips with rage, attacking other Christians online.
Hatred becomes a badge of loyalty — as long as it’s labeled “righteous.”
🧨 They’re not winning souls. They’re building echo chambers.
🔥 4. THE GOSPEL GETS DROWNED IN POLITICAL FIREWORKS
Non-believers hear Christians talking more about political plots than the blood of Jesus.
The Cross becomes a background prop to a nationalistic movement.
📖 Galatians 1:6–7
“...unto another gospel: Which is not another...”
🔥 5. DISCERNMENT IS DEAD — DECEPTION IS KING
When spiritual leaders refuse to fact-check, pray, or wait on the Lord, they become hosts for demonic data.
Emotional preaching without truth filters invites spiritual viruses into the body of Christ.
🧬 Fake news in the pulpit leads to fake fruit in the people.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“Brother John, what if the news is true, but the pastor uses it to promote fear and hate?”

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
Truth used without love becomes a weapon of the enemy.
🔥 Satan quoted Scripture to Jesus — and still remained the devil.
🔥 Preachers must handle truth with holiness, not hostility.

REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY — “I USED TO PREACH ANGER… THEN GOD STRUCK ME SILENT”
🧬 Verified Pattern | Spirit-Forged Case | Alias Assigned: Pastor R.J.
🔥 TRUE TESTIMONY — The Preacher Who Lost His Voice

Pastor R.J. led a growing church in a small province in the Philippines.
His sermons were fiery — but not from the Holy Ghost…
They were filled with rage, fake news, and political rants.

Every Sunday became a bash session against the government.
He reposted conspiracy threads as “prophetic words.”
He even claimed, “The Spirit told me this senator is the Antichrist.”

His people were stirred — not to repentance, but to rebellion.
Instead of prayer meetings, they organized political marches.
Instead of preaching Christ, he preached fear of vaccines, microchips, and government plots.
📛 But something happened…

One Sunday, as he stood up to preach — his voice disappeared.
He couldn’t speak.
For six weeks, he was mute.

Doctors found nothing.
His throat was fine.
But he could not speak when he stood at the pulpit.
He broke.

In desperation, he cried to God.
The Spirit whispered:
“You’ve used My altar for man’s fire. I shut your mouth before you destroyed more souls.”
He wept.

He deleted every video, every post, every “prophecy.”
He stood before his church and repented publicly.

Now? He preaches only Christ.
No politics.
No panic.
Only the Word.
Only the Cross.
Only the fire that sanctifies — not the one that stirs mobs.

His church is smaller now…
But it’s holier.
And his voice?
🔥 It’s back — this time, under Heaven’s control.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“What if I’ve done what Pastor R.J. did — but haven’t been caught yet?”

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
Don’t wait for public exposure or supernatural shutdown.
🔥 Repent while your voice still works.
🔥 Clean your altar before God cleans it for you.

FINAL CHALLENGE — WILL YOU LET GOD BURN THE POLITICS OUT OF YOUR PULPIT?
⚔️ SOUL STRIKE ZONE ACTIVATED | Line in the Spirit Drawn
🔥 This is not about political silence — this is about prophetic purity.
📖 Jeremiah 23:29 (KJV)
“Is not my word like as a fire? saith the Lord; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?”

God’s Word is meant to shatter lies, not support them.
It’s meant to melt hearts, not harden crowds.
It’s meant to draw people to Christ, not drag them into culture wars.
⚠️ HERE IS THE SOUL STRIKE:

If your “fire” stirs bitterness, rebellion, slander, and division —
Then it’s not holy fire.
It’s not revival.
🔥 It’s rot.
🔥 ARE YOU PREACHING FROM WOUNDS OR THE WORD?

Many preachers use the pulpit to release personal rage under the name of “prophetic boldness.”
But the real prophets in Scripture weren’t just bold — they were broken.

✅ They cried for their nation more than they criticized it.
✅ They stood in the gap — not on Facebook Live with an attitude.
✝️ THE CHALLENGE IS THIS:

Will you let God burn the mixture out of your message?
Will you fast from news and feast on the Word again?
Will you preach Christ crucified, not leaders vilified?
📖 1 Corinthians 2:2 (KJV)
“For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.”

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“Brother John, is it possible to recover a pulpit that’s been used for politics and poison?”

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
YES.
But not by pretending it didn’t happen.
🔥 It must be repented for — publicly, deeply, and doctrinally.
The altar must be cleansed. The scroll must be reset. The oil must be pure again.
🛐 This isn’t image repair. This is spiritual surgery.

FOOL’S RESPONSE VS. WISE RESPONSE — WHAT WILL YOU DO WITH THIS FIRE?
📡 Division Line Initiated | This is the Threshold Moment
🔥 All exposure leads to this: How will you respond?
❌ THE FOOL’S RESPONSE:

💬 “This is too harsh. God understands my emotions.”
💬 “It’s not fake news — it’s just strong conviction.”
💬 “I’m just telling the truth about the government!”
💬 “People need to wake up — even if I use fear.”

🩸 The fool mistakes bitterness for boldness.
🩸 The fool thinks views validate truth.
🩸 The fool turns God’s altar into a political battlefield.
📖 Proverbs 14:12 (KJV)
“There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.”
✅ THE WISE RESPONSE:

🔥 “Lord, I repent for mixing my rage with Your message.”
🔥 “I don’t want to be a voice of division — I want to be a voice of truth.”
🔥 “I choose to silence every lie I’ve repeated and submit to Your fire.”
🔥 “I want my pulpit to preach Christ — not campaigns.”
📖 Psalm 139:23–24 (KJV)
“Search me, O God… and see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.”

🕊️ The wise don't justify their old fire.
They put it on the altar — and let the real fire fall.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“What if I’ve already led others into this same trap?”

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
🔥 Then lead them out.
Don’t cover your tracks. Confess your error.
The same voice that misled must now repent publicly and restore intentionally.

WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT? — WILL GOD JUDGE YOU FOR THE WORDS YOU SHARED IN HIS NAME?
⚖️ JUDGMENT SIMULATION: NOW ACTIVE | TRUTH CROSS-EXAMINATION BEGINS
🕯 This is not about your politics. This is about your prophetic integrity.
💀 STAND BEFORE THE THRONE FOR A MOMENT…

Imagine dying tonight —
And standing before the Holy God you claimed to represent.
He looks at you and asks:

“Did you spread truth… or did you stir mobs?”
“Did you represent My Son… or misrepresent My heart?”
“Did I ever tell you to say what you said?”
📖 Matthew 12:36–37 (KJV)

“But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.”

🧬 “Idle” in Greek — argos — means “unproductive, careless, fruitless, empty.”
🔥 Words that don’t produce repentance or reveal Christ are not neutral — they are dangerous.
⏳ IF YOU DIED TONIGHT…

Would the angels rejoice over your sermons?
Or would your Facebook “prophecies” rise as evidence against you?

Would you meet the God of the Bible?
Or realize you crafted a god of your own political bias?
Would you hear:

“Well done, good and faithful servant.”
Or:
“Depart from Me… I never sent you.” (Jer. 23:21)

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“What if I thought I was doing the right thing — does that count?”

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
🔥 Deception is still judged — even if it felt right.
This is why repentance is urgent.
🔥 You don’t need to defend yourself — you need to lay down your microphone and let God rewire your fire.

SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS — HOW THE ENEMY USES PREACHERS TO PLANT DIVISION, NOT DELIVERANCE
🕷 DEMONIC STRATEGY INTERCEPTED | Cloaked In Zeal, Powered by Pride
🔥 Satan’s smartest tactic is not to silence the pulpit — but to pollute it.
🧠 REMEMBER THIS:

The devil doesn’t mind loud preachers.
He minds holy ones.
He minds truthful ones.
He minds crucified ones.
⚠️ SATAN’S CURRENT STRATEGY IN THE MODERN CHURCH:
🔥 1. REPLACE DOCTRINE WITH DRAMA
Satan trains preachers to shout about scandal, not preach repentance.
They become emotionally effective, but spiritually empty.
📖 2 Timothy 4:3–4
“They shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.”
🔥 2. TURN THE PULPIT INTO A POLITICAL STAGE
Satan whispers: “The Gospel isn’t enough — you need a cause!”
So they trade kingdom conviction for cultural outrage.
🔥 Result: People leave stirred, but not saved.
🔥 3. INFLATE THEIR PLATFORM — THEN INFECT THEIR MESSAGE
The enemy promotes pride by boosting views.
Soon, the preacher starts saying what the crowd demands, not what Heaven commands.
🧠 Satan doesn’t silence bold voices — he weaponizes them.
🔥 4. CONFUSE ZEAL WITH SPIRITUAL AUTHORITY
Rage is mistaken for boldness.
Hatred becomes “discernment.”
Division is called “standing for truth.”
📖 James 1:20
“The wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.”
🔥 5. DESENSITIZE THE BODY TO SLANDER & MOCKERY
The more preachers joke about leaders and mock others publicly,
The more gossip becomes godliness, and insults become instruction.
🧨 This poisons the sheep — while the wolf stays disguised in the pulpit.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“How can I know if I’ve been influenced by one of Satan’s fake fire preachers?”

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
Ask yourself:
✅ Do I feel closer to Jesus or just angrier at the world after hearing them?
✅ Are they pointing me to the Cross or to a cause?
✅ Are they feeding my soul or just fueling my frustration?

GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION — PUBLIC ALTAR CALL TO RENOUNCE POLITICAL FIRE AND RETURN TO PURE PREACHING
🔥 FINAL SURRENDER ZONE — ALTAR OF REPENTANCE IGNITED
📛 No more mixture. No more manipulation. No more microphones without mandate.
✝️ GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION: RETURN TO THE PURE FLAME
📖 Psalm 19:14 (KJV)
“Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O Lord…”
🗣️ Say this now — only if you mean it with holy fear:

“Jesus, I surrender my tongue, my mind, and my pulpit.
I renounce every word I spoke in Your Name that was not from Your heart.
I repent for sharing fake news, spreading slander, and calling it discernment.
I reject emotionalism masked as prophecy.
I choose the fire of holiness — not the fire of hype.

Forgive me for turning the Gospel into a campaign.
Forgive me for stirring mobs instead of saving souls.
Burn out every doctrine that wasn’t born at Calvary.
Burn out every rage I labeled as ‘righteous.’

I choose truth, even if it silences me.
I choose the Cross, even if it costs me my audience.
I choose to speak only when Heaven speaks.
No more mixture. No more manipulation.

I declare:
I am not saved by trend or tribe —
But only by total surrender.

🔥 I now submit fully to the A.S.I.S. Covenant —
Always Saved, If Surrendered.

Let this altar be my reset.
Let this fire be my filter.
Let my voice belong to Christ — from this day forward.
Amen.”

HOLY SPIRIT EMPOWERMENT DECREE — FRESH FIRE FOR CLEAN VESSELS ONLY
🕊️ INFUSION CHAMBER ENGAGED | BAPTISMAL RESET INITIATED
🔥 The altar has burned the mixture. Now the Spirit pours clean oil.
🛐 READ THIS ALOUD — A FRESH FILLING PRAYER

🗣️
“Holy Spirit, I welcome You without filters, without agendas.
Not for a platform — but for purification.
Not for popularity — but for power.
Not for politics — but for preaching truth.

I renounce every false fire I once entertained.
I renounce the mixture I tolerated and the hatred I reposted.
I open my mouth for You — not for man.

Baptize me again.
Fill me again.
Teach me to fear the Lord again.

🔥 Let my heart burn for Your glory, not for revenge.
🔥 Let my mouth preach repentance, not rebellion.
🔥 Let my hands build the Kingdom, not tear it down in rage.

From this day forward:
No lies will pass my lips.
No fake news will stain my hands.
No bitterness will fuel my messages.

I am now a vessel of truth.
A voice for Christ.
A preacher of purity.

Come, Holy Ghost.
Govern my fire.
Filter my feed.
Anoint my altar.
And never let me return to the man I was before this scroll.
Amen.”

WARFARE ASSIGNMENT — 5 FIRE ORDERS TO CLEAN YOUR PLATFORM, PREACH WITH PURITY, AND RECOVER YOUR GOSPEL VOICE
⚔️ DISCIPLESHIP CHARGE DEPLOYED | Tactical Obedience Required
🔥 The scroll doesn’t end with tears — it ends with transformation.
🚨 FIRE ORDER #1 — PURGE THE PLATFORM

Go through your social media today.
🧨 Delete every post, video, or comment that:
Spread unverified news
Stirred political rage instead of revival
Mocked leaders

Promoted conspiracy over Christ
🔥 Let the scroll cleanse your timeline.
🚨 FIRE ORDER #2 — ISSUE A PUBLIC APOLOGY OR CLARIFICATION

If you’ve preached or posted emotionally-driven, false, or hateful content:
🩸 REPENT OPENLY.
Not for reputation management — but for soul restoration.
🗣️ “I was wrong. I preached in emotion. I want to return to the pure Gospel.”
🔥 The pulpit’s honor must be restored through transparency.
🚨 FIRE ORDER #3 — FAST FROM POLITICAL MEDIA FOR 7 DAYS
No YouTube “watchmen”
No TikTok exposés

No rage reels
📖 Use the time to read:
The Book of Jeremiah
Titus (whole book)
Matthew 5–7 (Sermon on the Mount)
🔥 Detox your spirit. Realign with Heaven’s throne — not man’s throne.
🚨 FIRE ORDER #4 — PREACH ONE PURE GOSPEL MESSAGE THIS WEEK

No politics. No slander. No manipulation.
🔥 Just Jesus, the Cross, repentance, and surrender.
📡 Record it. Share it. Let it be your comeback scroll.
🚨 FIRE ORDER #5 — DISCIPLE SOMEONE OUT OF DECEPTION

Find one person who follows the same false voices you once did.
⚔️ Invite them into this scroll. Walk them out — like you were walked out.
🔥 This is not just your freedom — it’s now your assignment.

💭 READER RESPONSE CHALLENGE:
Which fire order are you starting with today?

🧬 Don't just say “Amen.”
🔥 Move. Obey. Execute.

title: Was Jesus Really Born on December 25? The Truth They Don’t Want You to Preach
paragraphs: Was Jesus Really Born on December 25? The Truth They Don’t Want You to Preach

Millions gather every year to celebrate December 25 as the birth of Jesus Christ.
Songs are sung. Sermons are preached. Nativities are staged.
But behind the lights, the gifts, and the nostalgia…
Lurks a dangerous assumption:
Was Jesus really born on December 25?
Or have we sacrificed truth on the altar of tradition?
💭 READER QUESTION:

What if celebrating the wrong date isn’t just a small issue —
But a spiritual distortion that feeds religious deception, hides ancient pagan roots, and mocks the very God we claim to honor?
📖 MAIN VERSE:
📜 John 1:14 (KJV)
“And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us…”

This verse celebrates the Incarnation — the eternal God entering human history.
But the timing of that event was never left to speculation — and Scripture gives us clues.

THE CORE TRUTH — GREEK & HEBREW BREAKDOWN OF THE BIRTH OF CHRIST
🧬 Scriptural Dissection Unlocked | Incarnation Coordinates Unveiling
🔥 The language of the Word pierces the veil of tradition.
✝️ THE WORD "BIRTH" — Greek: γεννάω (gennaō)
Meaning: to be begotten, brought forth, caused to be born

Used in relation to natural birth, but also spiritual and prophetic fulfillments.
🔎 Matthew 1:20 uses gennaō for Jesus being conceived of the Holy Ghost — not on December 25, but at a precise, God-ordained time.
✝️ THE WORD "FLESH" — Greek: σάρξ (sarx)
John 1:14 — “The Word became flesh”
This is not about a date on a Roman calendar — but about God entering time.
The Greek emphasizes a supernatural event, not a man-made holiday.
✝️ THE WORD "APPOINTED TIME" — Hebrew: מוֹעֵד (mo’ed)
Meaning: appointed place or feast, divine appointment

This word connects the birth, death, and resurrection of Christ to the biblical feasts, not pagan festivals.
📖 Leviticus 23:2 — “These are My appointed feasts…”

🔥 The Messiah does not move by human holiday schedules.
He fulfills divine mo’edim — appointed by the Father before the foundations of the world.

⚠️ Testimony: “I Gave to Be Seen… and I Almost Lost My Soul”
📍 Name: Samuel Ortiz
📍 Former Member, Mega-Church Manila
📍 Year: 2017–2020

“Every Sunday, they preached Acts 5. I remember the pastor slamming the pulpit yelling, ‘Don’t end up like Ananias! Don’t lie to the Holy Ghost—give your whole seed today!’
I was only making ₱5,000 a month. But I’d give ₱4,000 out of fear—because they said if I didn’t, I was ‘robbing God’ and ‘playing with death.’
The more I gave, the poorer I got. They said it was because I didn’t give enough.
I saw others giving even their wedding rings. One girl gave her tuition. Nothing changed.
After 3 years, I left broke, disillusioned, and angry at God.
But one day, I saw a video exposing this twisted theology. I realized Acts 5 wasn’t about giving money—it was about lying to God with a fake life.
I repented—not just from fear-based giving—but for ever believing God could be bribed.
Now I give freely. No pressure. Just love. I am no longer a manipulated giver. I am a surrendered disciple.”

✔️ Samuel didn’t die from not giving

“Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.”

🔥 Ananias & Sapphira were not judged because they gave too little.
They were judged because they acted holy while their hearts were filled with performance, pride, and pretense.

✔️ Repent for giving to be seen.
✔️ Repent for giving out of fear.
✔️ Repent for using Acts 5 to manipulate others (if you ever did).
✔️ Repent for believing God could be bribed.

God doesn’t want your money first.
He wants your truth. Your heart. Your full surrender.

You are not required to lie to fit in.
You are required to die to self to live in Him.

WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT? — ETERNITY CONFRONTATION DEPLOYED

Would He say:

title: “You’re Counting Down to 2026 — But Heaven Is Counting Your Soul”
paragraphs: “You’re Counting Down to 2026 — But Heaven Is Counting Your Soul”

People are celebrating the countdown.
Fireworks. Confetti. Champagne.
They’re shouting, “Happy New Year!”

But what if Heaven isn't celebrating?
What if Heaven is recording?

🎯 While you're counting seconds…
God is counting souls.
And your name is either in the Book of Life—
…or it isn't.

❓ READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“Brother John, if someone dies tonight before midnight — is it too late to repent?”
📖 MAIN VERSE — Hebrews 9:27 (KJV):
“And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment.”
🔥 You’re not promised 2026. You’re only promised one appointment: Judgment.
CORE TRUTH — THE CLOCK WON’T SAVE YOU
📖 Main Verse — Hebrews 9:27 (KJV):
“And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment.”
✝️ GREEK WORD BREAKDOWN:

“Appointed” – Greek: apokeimai (ἀπόκειμαι)
➤ Meaning: Reserved, laid up, unchangeable destiny
➤ Your death is not random. It's an eternal reservation.

“Judgment” – Greek: krisis (κρίσις)
➤ Meaning: Divine sentence, eternal separation or acceptance
➤ It’s not a review. It’s a ruling — with no appeal.
🔥 CORE TRUTH:

✔️ You can delay taxes.
✔️ You can reschedule meetings.
❌ But you can’t delay death.
❌ And you can’t skip judgment.

People are partying like they own tomorrow.
But Heaven doesn’t run on Earth’s calendar.
Midnight to man may be celebration — but to Heaven, it could be your final second.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“Does God really judge people on New Year’s Eve the same as any other night?”

📖 Answer: He doesn’t judge based on the date. He judges based on the soul.
Whether it's January 1st or December 31st — if you die without Christ, you face eternity.
BIBLICAL & HISTORICAL PROOF — THE FINAL COUNTDOWN IS REAL
📛 No hype. No superstition. Just Scripture and eternal truth.

📖 BIBLICAL PROOF — THE CLOCK WILL NOT SAVE YOU
🔥 Luke 12:19–20 (KJV):
“Thou hast much goods laid up for many years… But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee.”

✅ The man was counting his plans.
God was counting his last breath.
🔥 James 4:14 (KJV):
“For what is your life? It is even a vapor, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.”
✅ You are not a calendar. You are a soul on the edge of eternity.
🔥 Matthew 24:44 (KJV):
“Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.”
✅ The New Year won’t delay the King’s return. Are you ready?
📜 EARLY CHURCH TESTIMONY — THEY LIVED READY
🗣️ Ignatius of Antioch (c. 110 AD):
“Be watchful, for you know not when the Lord shall come. Let not your soul be found sleeping at the sound of His trumpet.”

📖 Source:
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0109.htm
🗣️ Clement of Rome (c. 95 AD):
“Let us fix our eyes on the blood of Christ… and be prepared, lest we be found unready at His appearing.”

📖 Source:
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/1010.htm

🧬 The early Church wasn’t watching fireworks.
They were watching the skies.
They didn’t wait for a new year—they waited for the return of Christ.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“If I’ve wasted the whole year in sin… can I still make it right tonight?”
Answer: Yes. But only if you stop delaying. The next second is not guaranteed.
OLD TESTAMENT PROPHETIC CONNECTIONS — THE FINAL NIGHT PATTERN

📜 The Old Covenant was filled with divine patterns of reckoning, judgment, and midnight deliverance.
December 31 isn't just a modern moment — it's a spiritual mirror of ancient prophetic themes.
🔥 Exodus 12:29 (KJV) — Midnight Judgment in Egypt
“And it came to pass, that at midnight the Lord smote all the firstborn…”

✅ At the stroke of midnight, judgment fell.
Those without the blood on the doorposts faced death.

🚨 Many are partying into 2026 without the blood of Jesus on their hearts.
But Heaven does not delay judgment for holidays.
🔥 Psalm 119:62 (KJV)
“At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.”

✅ The righteous worship at midnight. The foolish waste it.
For the remnant, midnight is not a party—it’s a prayer watch.
🔥 Daniel 5:26–27 (KJV) — Judgment Written While They Were Feasting
“Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.”

✅ King Belshazzar threw a feast with stolen vessels.
That very night — judgment struck.

⚠️ Just like tonight, people will raise glasses with stolen breath…
…not knowing it’s their last toast before eternal fire.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“Are we still under the same midnight patterns today?”
🧠 Answer: We are under grace, but God's timing still operates on holy patterns. The wise discern the signs — the foolish ignore the hour.
⚔️ The impact of this scroll in today's world must now be declared.
REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY — THE MIDNIGHT THAT NEVER CAME
⚠️ Testimony: “He Died Before the Countdown”

📍 Name: Kevin Lopez (Metro Manila, 2008)
📍 Age: 22
📍 Status: Lost in the party scene, died in a motor accident at 11:47 PM, December 31

“Kevin always said, ‘I’ll repent next year.’
He laughed at his aunt who invited him to church. ‘January 1 is my reset,’ he told her.

That night, he was drunk, driving home from a club. Fireworks echoed in the streets. His friends were posting countdown selfies.
But Kevin never made it to midnight.
A crash. Instant death. And a soul that had no covenant with Christ.

His funeral was filled with friends wearing black and posting #RIP.
But there was no peace. No hope. Just grief.
Because deep down… they all knew: he waited too long.

I (his cousin) surrendered my life to Jesus the next day.
I refuse to gamble with time like Kevin did.”
🔥 LESSON FROM KEVIN’S LIFE:

✔️ He had resolutions, but not repentance
✔️ He was close to 2026—but far from Jesus
✔️ He had time, but no truth
📖 Luke 13:3 (KJV):
“Except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.”

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“What if I don’t feel ready, but I’m scared of dying unprepared?”

🛡️ Answer: You don’t need to “feel ready.” You need to surrender.
The next second is not promised.
🔥 The Final Challenge comes next.
FINAL CHALLENGE — SURRENDER BEFORE THE CLOCK STRIKES

🕰 The countdown has already started.
This isn’t about goals, gym memberships, or New Year’s resolutions.
This is about your eternal destination.
📖 Acts 3:19 (KJV):
“Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out…”
❗ FINAL SOUL STRIKE:

✔️ You may live to see 2026
✔️ You may not
❌ But you will not escape judgment
❌ You will not bypass eternity

Jesus isn’t waiting for your calendar to flip.
He’s waiting for your heart to break.

📛 You can drink, dance, shout, and party tonight…
…but if your soul is still chained to sin — you are already spiritually dead.
⚔️ YOUR FINAL CHOICE BEFORE MIDNIGHT:

✔ Surrender now, while breath is still in your lungs
❌ Or gamble your soul and hope you wake up in 2026

The Book of Life will not update at midnight.
It only updates when you repent.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“If I pray now, will Jesus really forgive me after everything I’ve done this year?”
🧠 Answer: YES — if you mean it.
It’s time to draw the line between the Fool and the Wise.
FOOL’S RESPONSE VS. WISE RESPONSE — FINAL MIDNIGHT DIVIDE
📖 Proverbs 27:1 (KJV):
“Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.”
⚠️ THE FOOL’S RESPONSE (BEFORE THE CLOCK STRIKES):

❌ “I’ll surrender next year.”
❌ “Let me enjoy tonight, then I’ll repent.”
❌ “God understands I’m not ready yet.”
❌ “I’ll do better in 2026. For now, I just want peace.”
❌ “Brother John is being too extreme — it’s just a blog.”

🔥 The fool laughs while fire closes in.
🔥 The fool dances on the edge of the pit.
🔥 The fool thinks 2026 is guaranteed.
✅ THE WISE RESPONSE (RIGHT NOW):

✔ “Jesus, I repent before the countdown ends.”
✔ “I don’t want another fake year — I want new life.”
✔ “I refuse to enter another year in bondage.”
✔ “I choose surrender, not celebration without salvation.”
✔ “I will follow Christ before midnight — not just claim Him after.”
📖 Matthew 25:10 (KJV):
“...and the door was shut.”

⚠️ That’s what happened to the foolish virgins.
Don’t wait for the door to close.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“How do I cross over into 2026 ready?”
Answer: You don’t just cross over — you bow down.
WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT? — FINAL ETERNITY CHECKPOINT

🕛 Midnight is coming.
But what if your clock stops before it hits 12:00?
❓WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT?

Would you step into a new year…
…or a closed gate?

Would you enter 2026 with fireworks…
…or eternity with fire?
📖 Revelation 20:15 (KJV):
“And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.”

You don’t get into Heaven by starting a new year.
You get in by starting a new life in Christ.

There are no New Year’s resolutions in Hell.
Only regret.

There are no confetti celebrations in the Lake of Fire.
Only weeping and gnashing of teeth.
🧯 YOU HAVE 3 OPTIONS RIGHT NOW:
Delay until 12:01 and hope nothing happens.
Fall on your knees, and make peace with God — right now.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“Is it really that urgent?”
🧠 Answer: The trumpet won’t wait for your alarm clock.
⚔️ We now expose the final deception — the delay strategy of Satan.
SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS — MIDNIGHT DECEPTION EXPOSED

👿 Satan doesn’t need you to reject Jesus.
He just needs you to delay surrender — until it's too late.
⚠️ SNEAK ATTACK #1: “You Have More Time”

🧨 Lie: “You’re young. You’ll get serious next year.”
🔥 Truth: Kevin thought so too. He died at 11:47 PM.
📖 Luke 21:34 (KJV):
“Take heed… lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.”
⚠️ SNEAK ATTACK #2: “God Knows Your Heart”

🧨 Lie: “God understands. He’ll wait.”
🔥 Truth: He knows your heart is hardening.
📖 Hebrews 3:15 (KJV):
“Today if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts…”
⚠️ SNEAK ATTACK #3: “Just Tithe, Pray, and Start the Year Right”

🧨 Lie: “Do the usual: sow a seed, attend a service, and you’re good.”
🔥 Truth: God wants your soul, not a ceremony.
📖 Isaiah 1:13 (KJV):
“Bring no more vain oblations… it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.”

🧬 Satan’s plan isn’t to make you hate God.
It’s to keep you distracted until your window closes.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“What if I’ve believed these lies before? Will God still take me back tonight?”
🛡️ YES — but you must come now. The scroll is almost sealed.
GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION — SURRENDER BEFORE THE COUNTDOWN ENDS

📛 This is not a New Year’s prayer.
This is your eternal reset.
Not a resolution — but a repentance.
📖 Romans 10:9 (KJV):
“That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.”
🔥 GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION — SAY THIS OUT LOUD:

“Lord Jesus, I refuse to gamble with time.
I repent for every second I’ve wasted.
I confess my sins, my pride, my delay, and my rebellion.
I surrender not just my 2025, but my soul, my life, and my eternity.
I believe You died for me. I believe You rose again.
And before this year ends — I declare You as Lord.
I will not step into 2026 in sin. I step in as a new creation.
I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR — covered by the blood, filled with fire, and ready for the trumpet.
In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN!”
🔥 “I SURRENDER BEFORE THE CLOCK STRIKES!” 🔥

🔥 A.S.I.S. Certified — Always Saved, If Surrendered

title: When Failure Didn’t Get the Final Word
paragraphs: When Failure Didn’t Get the Final Word

The scandal:
Peter was loud with faith.
“I’ll die for You, Lord.”
Then one fire, one question, one fearful night…
and Peter denied Jesus three times.
Not before strangers only — but while Jesus was suffering nearby.
When the rooster crowed, Peter didn’t argue theology.
He wept. Broken. Ashamed. Exposed.

The silence:
After the resurrection, Peter didn’t preach.
He went back to fishing — back to what he knew before the calling.
That’s what shame does. It sends you backward.

The grace moment:
On the shore, Jesus cooked breakfast.
Not a sermon. Not a rebuke.
Just a question asked three times —
“Do you love Me?”

Each question healed one denial.
Each answer rewrote a failure.

The restoration:
Jesus didn’t say, “Why did you fail?”
He said, “Feed My sheep.”
The same mouth that denied Him
was trusted again to proclaim Him.

The Gospel truth:
Peter’s worst night didn’t cancel his calling.
It prepared him for grace.
The cross already paid for the denial
before it ever happened.

Jesus connection:
This is what Jesus does.
He meets failures with forgiveness,
shame with breakfast,
and endings with new assignments.
Key Verse:

“The Lord turned and looked straight at Peter.” — Luke 22:61
That look wasn’t rage.
It was mercy.
💔➡️✝️ INVITATION

If this year exposed you like Peter —
Jesus is not done.
Come to the shore.
Let Him ask you again.
Grace is calling you forward, not back.

paragraphs: 📜 The Names We Skip… God Didn’t.
Brother John here — and this one’s heavy, but full of hope.

Most of us rush past the genealogy at the start of Matthew.
Names. Lists. Easy to skip.
But slow down — because buried in that family line are scandals we’d rather forget.

Tamar — used and silenced.
Rahab — labeled and dismissed.
Bathsheba — wounded by a king’s abuse of power.

And yet… God didn’t erase them.
He wrote them in.

Jesus didn’t come from a polished family tree.
He stepped straight into human mess — on purpose.
Because grace doesn’t start with perfection.
Grace starts with truth.

And that’s the scandal and the beauty of grace:
God didn’t clean the story before entering it.
He entered it to redeem it.

So hear me today — if your past feels too complicated, too public, too broken…
You are not disqualified.
You might actually be exactly the kind of story God loves to use.

Jesus stepped into that lineage
so He could step into your life.
“Judah the father of Perez and Zerah, whose mother was Tamar…” — Matthew 1:3

Which part of your story do you think God can’t use anymore?
We’ll believe for grace together.

title: 💔 THE HARDEST HITS DON’T COME FROM THE ENEMY.
paragraphs: 💔 THE HARDEST HITS DON’T COME FROM THE ENEMY.
Body: A gospel warrior takes hits from both enemies and friends. Only one of those actually hurts. ⚔️🥀

When the world attacks you, you expect it. You have your shield up. You’re ready. But when the attack comes from inside the camp—from the people you prayed for, the people you trusted—it bypasses your armor and hits your heart.
If you are bleeding from a wound caused by a "friend" today, know this: You are in good company. Jesus had a Judas. David had an Absalom.
The betrayal didn't stop their purpose, and it won't stop yours. Forgive them, not because they deserve it, but because a Warrior cannot fight effectively while carrying the weight of bitterness.
Bind the wound. Keep marching. 🛡️👣
The Word:
"If an enemy were insulting me, I could endure it; if a foe were rising against me, I could hide. But it is you, a man like myself, my companion, my close friend..." — Psalm 55:12-13 (NIV)

title: Stop mourning what you lost and start preparing for what’s coming. 🔥
paragraphs: Stop mourning what you lost and start preparing for what’s coming. 🔥

Don't give up in the middle of the transition. The upgrade is imminent.

title: 🚫 NO ENCOUNTER IS ACCIDENTAL.
paragraphs: 🚫 NO ENCOUNTER IS ACCIDENTAL.
We met for a reason. Either you're a blessing or a lesson. 🤝📚
God does not waste people. He is intentional with every hello and every goodbye.
Some people are sent as Blessings: to encourage you, sharpen you, and run the race beside you. Others are allowed as Lessons: to teach you patience, discernment, or how to set boundaries.
Don't resent the "lessons." Judas was just as necessary to Jesus' destiny as John was. One betrayed Him, the other loved Him, but both played a part in the plan.
If they stay, cherish them. If they hurt you, learn from them. But never doubt that God is using every relationship to mold you into who you need to be.
The Word:
"And we know that in all things [and all people] God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose." — Romans 8:28 (NIV)

title: STOP bleeding from wounds inflicted by people just looking for clout. 🛑🗣️
paragraphs: STOP bleeding from wounds inflicted by people just looking for clout. 🛑🗣️

title: 🫵 STOP BLAMING BAD LUCK.

title: 🛑 STOP STEALING YOUR OWN PEACE.
paragraphs: 🛑 STOP STEALING YOUR OWN PEACE.

The enemy attacks you with Guilt to keep you stuck in yesterday, and Anxiety to keep you paralyzed by tomorrow. Why? Because if he can keep your mind in the past or the future, he steals your power in the PRESENT.

title: We exhaust ourselves trying to present a polished, doubt-free version of Christianity to God.

title: Born in a Scandal, Raised in Glory
paragraphs: Born in a Scandal, Raised in Glory

Jesus didn’t enter the world through applause —
He came through whispers, suspicion, and a borrowed stable.

Mary carried questions.
Joseph carried quiet shame.
Bethlehem carried rumors.
But heaven carried a plan.

God didn’t wait for a clean story —
He stepped straight into a messy one.
The baby laid in a manger would one day stretch His arms on a cross.
And the cross would give way to an empty grave.

The world judged His beginning.
Death thought it won His ending.
But resurrection had the final word.

If God can redeem the night He was born,
He can redeem the season you’re in right now.
Key Verse:
“He is not here; He has risen, just as He said.” — Matthew 28:6

Invitation:
Where do you need resurrection today?
Name it in prayer. Grace is not finished with you.
